notes.title: Massive Update - The First of Many!
notes.content:
Commanders, the next era of Athralis Tower Defense begins now! This is the first of many major updates rolling out over the next few months, bringing huge campaign revamps, new enemies, improved mechanics, and fresh content to the battlefield.

[b]Campaign Overhaul[/b]

[list]
[*] Revamped Tutorial Map & UI Update for a smoother experience.
[*] Campaign Maps Enhanced with new objects, background terrain, and unique mechanics.
[*] First-Ever Campaign Cutscenes to bring the story to life!
[*] All Campaign Maps Are Now Playable! – The first campaign map is fully available with cutscenes and campaign functionality. The rest of the maps have been temporarily placed in Defense/Spotlight Mode until they are fully integrated into the campaign. You can still play them now, but they will not yet have cutscenes or campaign-specific mechanics.
[/list]

[b]New Functionality & Mechanics[/b]

[list]
[*] Cutscenes & Background Terrain Models for deeper immersion.
[*] Wave Mode Improvements & Better Edit Mode UI.
[*] Colorable Lighting & Trigger Object ID Setter in Edit Mode.
[*] Towers now increase in price per placement for better balance.
[*] Campaign Maps now have unique loadouts separate from the Arsenal Loadout.
[/list]

[b]Entity & Enemy Updates[/b]

[list]
[*] New Enemy Models & Improved Movement.
[*] New Foes Join the Fight: Heavy Skrizik & Guardian Drone.
[*] Drones & Mechs Now Fire at Towers, adding a new challenge!
[*] New Tower Type: Spawner Towers – Deploy units that travel to the enemy spawn.
[/list]

[b]Audio & Music Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] New Lobby Soundtrack.
[*] New Wave Mode & Bossfight Music.
[/list]

[b]Map & Object Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Customizable Light Properties.
[*] New Environmental Objects: Mushrooms, Pine Trees, Snowy Pine Trees.
[*] New Interactive Objects: Rocket Silo Trigger, Additional Trigger Objects.
[*] Several Map-Specific Objects for More Dynamic Battlefields.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay & UI Enhancements[/b]

[list]
[*] Major Balancing Improvements.
[*] Refined UI for a Smoother Experience.
[/list]

This update is just the beginning—expect even bigger content drops in the coming months! Jump in now, test the new campaign maps, and experience the first fully functional level with cutscenes and dialogue. Keep in mind that aspects of the cutscenes and dialogue are subject to change as we are trying to constantly improve the user’s experience. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue expanding and refining the game. 

[b]Prepare for battle, Commander. The Athral Vanguard is only getting stronger.[/b]

notes.title: Nexus Chips Now Available for Purchase in Athralis Tower Defense!
notes.content:
[b]Attention, Commanders![/b]

We’re excited to introduce a new option for you in [i]Athralis Tower Defense[/i]! You can now purchase [i]Nexus Chips[/i] directly in the game, offering a faster way to enhance your strategy. Whether you choose to earn Nexus Chips through gameplay or purchase them, you'll have the resources needed to gain the upper hand!

[b]What Are Nexus Chips?[/b]

[i]Nexus Chips[/i] are the in-game currency that can be earned by playing or purchased for those who want to speed up their progress. Use them to unlock powerful towers, special power-ups, and other exclusive content in the shop.

[b]Grind or Buy – The Choice is Yours![/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Earn Nexus Chips:[/b] Play through the game and earn Nexus Chips with each victory. It's all about strategy and persistence!
[*] [b]Buy Nexus Chips:[/b] If you're looking to enhance your arsenal faster, Nexus Chips can also be purchased directly from the in-game store, allowing you to unlock the most powerful items sooner.
[/list]

[b]How to Use Nexus Chips:[/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]Visit the Shop:[/b] Head to the in-game shop to purchase power-ups, towers, and more with your Nexus Chips.
[*] [b]Upgrade Faster:[/b] Whether you choose to grind or buy, Nexus Chips let you quickly acquire the tools you need to face the toughest waves of the Athral Vanguard.
[/olist]

[b]Prepare for battle, Commanders! The Athral Vanguard won’t know what hit them.[/b]

notes.title: New Map & Power-Up Now Available in Athralis Tower Defense!
notes.content:
[b]Attention, Commanders![/b]

We're excited to bring you another thrilling update for Athralis Tower Defense! This time, we're introducing a brand-new map and an innovative power-up that will give you even more strategic options on the battlefield.

[b]What's New:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]New Map: Mountainous Military Base[/b] Get ready to defend in a whole new environment! The Mountainous Military Base map takes you to a snowy mountain stronghold. Can you outlast the relentless waves of the Athral Vanguard in this frozen battlefield?
[*] [b]New Power-Up: Warp Bomb (50% Off!)[/b] Introducing the Warp Bomb, a powerful new tool in your arsenal! When used in conjunction with the COMS Antenna, the Warp Bomb teleports enemies back a random distance, giving you extra time to reinforce your defenses. For a limited time, you can grab the Warp Bomb at 50% off—don’t miss out on this opportunity to strengthen your defenses!
[/list]

[b]Stay Tuned:[/b]

We’re committed to bringing you fresh content and exciting new features. As always, we welcome your feedback and suggestions on the community forums.

Thank you for your continued support. Prepare for battle and dominate the new Mountainous Military Base with your Warp Bombs!

[b]Charge into the fray, Commanders![/b]

notes.title: Steam Workshop Now Available + UI Enhancements for Athralis Tower Defense!
notes.content:
Attention, Commanders!

We are thrilled to announce that Steam Workshop support is now live for Athralis Tower Defense! This highly requested feature allows you to create, share, and download custom maps and content directly within the game.

But that's not all! We've also implemented several quality-of-life improvements to enhance your gaming experience:

[b]What's New:[/b]

[b]Steam Workshop Integration:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Custom Maps: [/b]Explore an ever-expanding library of community-created maps or design your own battlefield! The Workshop makes it easy to upload and share your creations with players worldwide.
[*] [b]Steam Cloud Support:[/b] All your downloaded maps will be automatically stored in the Steam Cloud, ensuring you can access them from any device.
[*] [b]Community Collaboration: [/b]Connect with other players and creators. Rate, comment, and provide feedback on your favorite maps, helping to highlight the best content.
[/list]

UI Enhancements:

[list]
[*] [b]New Font: [/b]We've refreshed the look of the game with a brand-new font for all in-game text, improving readability and giving the game a sleek, sci-fi feel.
[*] [b]Save Button in Edit Mode: [/b]We've added a save button to the pause screen in edit mode, making it easier than ever to save your progress while working on your custom maps.
[/list]

[b]Important Notice:[/b]

We want to remind all players that content uploaded to the Steam Workshop must adhere to Steam's content guidelines. Any maps or content that violate these guidelines will be removed, and further actions may be taken against the offending accounts. We encourage all creators to review Steam's Workshop Guidelines before submitting their content to ensure it complies with the rules.

[b]Stay Tuned:[/b]

This is just the beginning! We're eager to see what the community creates and will continue to support and improve the Workshop experience based on your feedback. Be sure to share your thoughts with us on the community forums.

Thank you for your continued support. We can't wait to see the amazing maps you'll create!

[b]Prepare for battle, Commanders![/b]

More Content and Features coming up next week!

Happy Defending!

The Athralis Tower Defense Team

notes.title: Update: New Lightning Turret & Limited-Time Discount!
notes.content:
[b]Athralis Tower Defense - Update Announcement![/b]

Commanders,

We have an electrifying update for you! Introducing the Lightning Turret to your arsenal. This new turret promises to bring a new strategic edge to your defenses.

[b]Update Highlights:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]New Lightning Turret:[/b] Unleash the power of lightning against your enemies. This turret is designed to deliver high damage to multiple targets at once. The cost to place a Lightning Turret on the battlefield is 750 credits.
[*] [b]Limited-Time Discount:[/b] For a limited time, the Lightning Turret is available at 50% off, costing only 25 in-game currency.
[/list]

[b]What's Next?[/b]

More updates are coming in the next week! Stay tuned for new features, improvements, and more exciting content.

Thank you for your continued support and for being part of the Athralis Tower Defense community.

Happy defending!

The Athralis Tower Defense Team
